semantics.decisionProgress: Observed values include 董事會擬議, 董事會決議, 股東會確認; parse as state, not as one universal finality flag.
semantics.distributionSource: Cash and stock distributions are source-separated across earnings, legal reserve and capital reserve fields.
semantics.boardDate: 董事會（擬議）股利分派日 is a decision/proposal date candidate, not an exact publication timestamp.
semantics.shareholderDate: 股東會日期 is a governance/finality date when present, not ex-date or payment date.
semantics.reportDate: 出表日期 is current dataset generation date and must not be backfilled as historical first-known.

twseOpenApi.currentSnapshotLimitation: The public OpenAPI endpoint is verified as a current snapshot. This run did not prove immutable historical vintages of the same row, so it cannot by itself establish historical proposal-to-final correction lineage.

verifiedCapabilities: 股利分派頻率與決議層級
mops.role: Candidate canonical event/version source for proposal/final/correction chronology; exact historical machine replay and immutable first-known timestamps remain to be physically validated.

twseCorporateAction.observedContract: T48 ex-right/ex-dividend and listing information file; daily; source page states production at 23:00 on each announcement day; data start 2019-12-23; licensed product.
twseCorporateAction.role: Documents that a deterministic licensed corporate-action lane exists; public research must not silently inherit this licensed history.

witnessedStates.inference: A positive cash distribution can be capital-reserve-funded even when current net income is negative; nominal DPS alone is not earnings-supported payout.

witnessedStates.note: Board-authorized future adjustment of per-share cash rate if shares outstanding change before the ex-dividend record date.
witnessedStates.inference: Decision amount/rate and later ex-date share denominator require lineage; a single current row is insufficient for immutable PIT replay.
The source explicitly distinguishes a proposal state from confirmed/final states.

failClosed: Unknown progress labels remain UNKNOWN and never map to FINAL.
Blank shareholder-meeting date does not imply missing or invalid dividend; quarterly board-only distributions can be legitimate.
Zero current-period net income does not imply zero distributable capacity; retained earnings/reserve sources must remain separate.
Current OpenAPI rows may not be used to reconstruct earlier first-known values without archived raw receipts.
Stock dividends are not cash outflows.
Ex-date/payment clocks must come from their canonical event sources and cannot be inferred from board/shareholder dates.

falsification: If historical MOPS/TWSE retrieval cannot preserve proposal/final/correction vintages without overwrite, historical replay remains blocked and only prospective receipts are valid.
If decision-progress labels are not stable across eras, parser versions must be date-bounded rather than silently normalized.
If distribution-source fields are revised after first publication, the pre-revision receipt remains the only valid earlier PIT state.
If source coverage systematically excludes special distributions or financial institutions, D07-34 cannot generalize without a separate lane.
exactNext: Capture raw MOPS dividend-distribution and related material-information receipts for at least one proposal-to-final or correction lineage.
Preserve raw bytes/hash, firstObservedAt, capturedAt, company, fiscal period, decision state and source classification append-only.
Join ex-date/payment only from canonical event sources.
Validate ordinary cash, reserve-funded cash, stock dividend and financial-institution exception before any L3 claim.
